raised: The fee is a 2025 average, not a promise of what the reader would be charged
The table is sorted from most to least expensive, which the reader would have misread without the note
The '123 ממקור / מחושב / הזנתה' legend is confusing, and its meaning for the user is unclear
It is unclear whether the separate 'עוקב מדדי מניות' button is the same thing as the S&P track
The 'PF-06' tag means nothing to the reader
The turquoise/yellow rings and the מניות/מט"ח percentages are not understood (for example, is 101% foreign currency risky?)
Ayalon's ring is not closed, which seems odd for an S&P tracker
Only the Altshuler and Analyst rows show a track name under the company, leaving the reader unsure whether all rows are the same thing
No yearly cost in shekels for the user's balance; the reader had to work it out
Cannot find whether the fee can be negotiated, or what a new customer would actually pay
Cannot find how to move an existing keren, or whether that costs anything or creates a tax problem
Unclear whether 0.48% covers all costs or whether there are extra costs, such as the index fund's own fees
Would drop the 'כסף מנוהל' column and the line under each company name
Would hide the 'קופה' numbers behind the arrow
Would drop the less relevant product buttons and the search box

problems.why: The reader asks why only the Altshuler and Analyst rows show an extra track-name line under the company and the others don't, which is the same inconsistency the person named.
